findings.passage: “I’m proud to add my signature to this petition and stand with my colleagues to get this issue before the voters,” Olsommer said. “Trust in our election system is vital to the integrity of the process. It’s time we deliver this commonsense reform to Pennsylvanians.”
findings.note: Statement in a House caucus release after he signed the discharge resolution to move House Bill 891 (constitutional amendment requiring ID each time a person votes) out of committee. Release is from his first days in office (sworn in 2024-05-21); exact release day not shown on fetched page. Same quote also printed by The River Reporter on 2024-05-29.
